name: btn-rotating-gradient
title: Rotating Gradient Button
description: A rounded call-to-action button with white text and a thin two-tone conic gradient that circles its border, making the outline brighten and fade as it travels.
use: A primary action on a dark hero needs to draw the eye without loud colour or size.
avoid: Busy pages or light themes: the dark pill and fixed purple-blue gradient may clash with brand colours.
a11y: The spinning border ignores prefers-reduced-motion, so motion-sensitive users get a perpetual animation; a native button keeps it keyboard-operable. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A centred pill-shaped button on a near-black stage: dark navy interior with white 'Book a demo' text, enclosed by a thin ring that shifts between pale blue and white as it circles the button.
behaves: The conic gradient ring spins steadily around the button's outline, so the border brightens and dims as the colours travel. The button itself stays still; the source adds a focus ring on keyboard focus.
customise: Pass the label as children and a className to extend the button; the gradient colours, spin speed and radius are fixed in the source and need editing.
weight: light: Two spans and a single CSS spin animation; no JavaScript or canvas.
demo: The button label reads 'Book a demo'.
issues: The pale ring is very faint in frames 1 and 2, so the effect is easy to miss.
polishWhy: Tidy pill with a smooth, even spin; the gradient ring is too faint to notice in some frames.
